description: This file defines the 'FieldStorageReuseForm' class in the Drupal 'field_ui' module, providing a form interface for reusing existing field storage configurations across entity types and bundles.

classes.name: Drupal ield_ui/Form ieldStorageReuseForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for reusing existing field storage configurations across entity types and bundles.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array for the reuse field storage interface.

methods.name: getExistingFieldStorageOptions
methods.description: Retrieves existing field storage options that can be reused, filtering out non-configurable, locked, or already used storages.

methods.name: reuseCallback
methods.description: Handles the reusing of an existing field storage configuration, creating a new field config and updating display settings.

methods.description: No-op; actual actions are handled by individual button callbacks.

methods.name: getExistingFieldDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default configuration options from an existing field and bundle for reuse.
